_meta.scope: 28 candidates (24 at first pass + Ball, LaCroix, Lee, McFadden added for the Oct 30 SF CCB review): 78701 and 94103 non-judges with 0 main points, and the trailing candidates in 6 unbalanced races (tx-ag, tx-agcomm, ca-ad-17, sf-supervisor-10, sf-board-of-education, sf-community-college-board). tx-comptroller is covered via Echavarria-Garza.
_meta.scale: -5..+5 on the feat2/lib/issues.ts axes; score null + status "unsure" means ambiguous and not scored.
_meta.fairness: Same protocol for every candidate: (1) official guide (LWV Austin PDF for 78701; SF VIP PDF plus the CA SOS guide index for 94103), (2) Ballotpedia page (HTTP 202 retry built in), (3) the campaign site when Ballotpedia, the guide or ballots.json lists one, (4) one questionnaire source: ATPE for SBOE, GrowSF Nov 2026 for SF, Texas Tribune race guide for TX statewide. Fetched 12:09-12:15 PM CT, about 55 requests.
rulesApplied: candidate own words only; no news paraphrase as a stance; no paid services
charter-only statements not scored on education
public-employee pay not scored on wages
one sentence counts toward one issue

administrative offices only (clerk, treasurer, constable, appraisal district, ACC; extended to sf-community-college-board at the Oct 30 review, not to any other office and not to sf-community-college-board-partial): a concrete stated priority on the office's own work is stored as an unscored officePriorities item (issue "office priorities"); build shows at most 1 per candidate so a race does not go from 1-vs-1 to 3-vs-1
flags: No new scored stances: every new line found was a slogan, off-axis, charter-only, public-employee pay, or mixed.

LaShawn Nash (write-in, County Clerk) is in the LWV guide p.23 but not in ballots.json; none of the 9 write-ins the LWV guide lists (US Senate, US House, AG, County Clerk, Williamson Pct. 4) is in ballots.json, so not added (see .md).

Review (Oct 30): office-priority rule extended to sf-community-college-board only, same sources (SF VIP, campaign site, GrowSF, Ballotpedia), max 1 shown point, concrete priorities only. sf-community-college-board-partial (Ruth Ferguson) is not included.
velvaprice.com and votedyana.com failed again (HTTP 000/500), as in batch 3.
LWV lists Trevor Hale's campaign website as en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trevor_Hale; not used.
VIP lists Lisa Wynn as "Lisa Palagi Wynn II".
Peña's and Muñoz's campaign site is the joint demsfortcad.com (third-person copy); Ballotpedia lists it as Muñoz's campaign website.
Review (Oct 30): Padilla's training/accountability line dropped as a slogan.
